title: A loan NEITHER charged off nor written off credits INCOME_FROM_BUY_DOWN and debits DEFERRED_INCOME_LIABILITY for a buy-down fee amortization (loan 1 L6: CREDIT account 24 50.00, DEBIT account 22 50.00)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the TWO-LEG journal entry a BUY_DOWN_FEE_AMORTIZATION transaction posts on a loan that is NEITHER charged off NOR written off, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES) at the amortization transaction L6. request.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's amortization transaction id 6 (type loanTransactionType.buyDownFeeAmortization): interestPortion 50.0 -> "5000" and feeChargesPortion 0 -> "0" minor units. The loan is NOT charged off, NOT written off and NOT fraud, so no loan-state input is set. request.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal.accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES.json: incomeFromBuyDownAccountId 24, deferredIncomeLiabilityAccountId 22, writeOffAccountId 15, chargeOffExpenseAccountId 18, chargeOffFraudExpenseAccountId 16. expect.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L6 legs in id order from the journal-entries sweep: id 13 entryType CREDIT glAccountId 24 amount 50.0 and id 14 DEBIT glAccountId 22 amount 50.0. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a buy-down fee amortization credits the one income account the loan state selects and debits the same total to deferred income liability, both portions sharing each account so the result is ONE merged credit then ONE debit. THIS NORMAL OBSERVATION IS THE CONTROL for the ignore-loan-state drive: a port that always credits income from buy down posts the SAME legs here, and it is the written-off, charged-off and charged-off-fraud siblings that move the credit account. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the loan-state switch (this loan is neither charged off, written off nor fraud), the merge of a positive interest AND fee portion (the fee portion is zero), and the buy-down-fee CLASSIFICATION and charge-off-REASON branches (not observed, no input). Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
